test_cases.title: Account locks after 5 consecutive failed login attempts
test_cases.pre_conditions: A registered shopper account aurora.shopper@example.com exists, is active, and has 0 recorded failed attempts; the shopper is on https://staging.aurora-shop.dev/login
steps: Enter 'aurora.shopper@example.com' in the email field
Enter an incorrect password and submit the login form
Repeat the incorrect password submission 4 more times within 15 minutes
Observe the response after the 5th failed attempt
test_cases.expected_result: After the 5th consecutive failure the account is locked; the shopper sees 'Account locked. Reset your password or try again later.'; a notification email is sent to aurora.shopper@example.com; no authentication occurs
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Account locks after 5 consecutive failed attempts
  Given a registered shopper is on the login page
  When they submit an incorrect password 5 consecutive times within 15 minutes
  Then the account is locked
  And the shopper sees the locked-account message
  And a notification email is sent
test_cases.traceability: lock after 5 consecutive failed login attempts

test_cases.title: Account unlocks automatically after 30 minutes
test_cases.pre_conditions: Shopper account aurora.shopper@example.com is locked and the lock timestamp is more than 30 minutes old
steps: Navigate to https://staging.aurora-shop.dev/login
Enter 'aurora.shopper@example.com' and the correct password
Submit the login form
test_cases.expected_result: The account is unlocked automatically; the shopper is authenticated and redirected to the account dashboard; the failed-attempt counter is reset to 0
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Automatic unlock after the lockout window
  Given a shopper account was locked more than 30 minutes ago
  When they log in with the correct password
  Then the account is unlocked
  And the shopper is redirected to the dashboard

test_cases.title: Locked account rejects any further login attempts
steps: Navigate to https://staging.aurora-shop.dev/login
Enter 'aurora.shopper@example.com' and the correct password
Submit the login form twice in quick succession
test_cases.expected_result: No authentication is attempted for the locked account; the locked-account message is shown; the failed-attempt counter does not increase; no session token is issued
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Locked account rejects further attempts
  Given a shopper account is locked
  When they submit valid credentials
  Then no authentication occurs
  And the failed-attempt counter does not increase

test_cases.title: SQL injection in the login email field is rejected
test_cases.pre_conditions: The shopper is on the login page
steps: Enter "' OR '1'='1" in the email field
Enter any password and submit the form
Repeat with the password field
test_cases.expected_result: The login is rejected with a generic validation message; no account is authenticated; the Postgres audit log records no successful authentication; input is handled as data, never executed
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Injection attempt in the login form is rejected
  Given a shopper is on the login page
  When they submit an SQL injection string in the email or password field
  Then the login is rejected
  And no account is authenticated

test_cases.title: 4 failed attempts do not lock the account; 5th attempt within 15 minutes does
test_cases.pre_conditions: A registered active shopper account with 0 failed attempts exists
steps: Submit an incorrect password 4 times within 15 minutes
Submit the correct password and verify login succeeds
Log out, then submit an incorrect password 5 times within 15 minutes
test_cases.expected_result: After 4 failures the account still authenticates with the correct password; exactly at the 5th consecutive failure within the window the account locks; the boundary value 5 is enforced precisely
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Lockout boundary at exactly 5 attempts
  Given a registered shopper with no failed attempts
  When they fail 4 times and then log in successfully
  Then the account is not locked
  When they later fail 5 times within 15 minutes
  Then the account locks
test_cases.traceability: 5 consecutive failed login attempts within 15 minutes

test_cases.title: Failed attempts older than 15 minutes fall outside the window
test_cases.pre_conditions: A registered active shopper account exists; the test environment clock can be observed or the attempt records are inspectable in Postgres
steps: Record 4 failed attempts more than 15 minutes ago
Submit one more incorrect password now
Submit the correct password
test_cases.expected_result: The new failure counts as the 1st within the current 15-minute window; the account does not lock; login with the correct password succeeds
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Stale failures outside the 15-minute window
  Given 4 failed attempts recorded more than 15 minutes ago
  When the shopper fails once more
  Then the account does not lock
  And a correct login succeeds

test_cases.title: Failed attempts accumulate across different browsers and sessions
test_cases.pre_conditions: A registered active shopper account exists; two browsers (Chromium and Firefox) are available
steps: In Chromium, submit an incorrect password 3 times
In Firefox, submit an incorrect password 2 more times within the same 15-minute window
Observe the account state
test_cases.expected_result: The account locks because failures accumulate per account, not per session; the shopper sees the locked-account message in both browsers; a single notification email is sent
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Cross-session accumulation of failed attempts
  Given a shopper fails 3 times in one browser
  When they fail 2 more times in another browser within 15 minutes
  Then the account locks
  And exactly one notification email is sent
test_cases.traceability: 5 consecutive failed login attempts within 15 minutes

test_cases.title: Lockout email link reuse after unlock does not re-lock or error
test_cases.pre_conditions: Shopper account is locked; a lockout notification email with an account link is in the inbox; the account is unlocked via password reset before the link is opened
steps: Complete the password reset flow to unlock the account
Open the lockout notification email and click the account link
Attempt to log in with the new password
test_cases.expected_result: The link opens the account page without errors; the account remains unlocked; login with the new password succeeds; no duplicate or stale lock state exists in Postgres
test_cases.bdd_scenario:
Scenario: Stale lockout email after unlock
  Given the account was unlocked via password reset
  When the shopper opens the old lockout email link
  Then the account page loads without errors
  And the account stays unlocked
test_cases.traceability: notified by email when the account locks

summary.automation_coverage_potential: 75%  --  Six of eight cases are automatable against staging; the time-window boundary case needs clock control and the stale-email case is manual-only.
coverage_gaps: Load behaviour of the login endpoint under lockout hammering is not covered (performance focus not selected)
Accessibility of the locked-account message with screen readers is not covered
Admin/support-agent forced unlock flow is out of scope of this story
recommendations: Automate TC-001, TC-003, TC-004, and TC-007 as Playwright smoke tests in CI
Add a contract test for the failed-attempt counter reset on successful login
Confirm the email template and sender address for lockout notifications with the team
Load-test the login endpoint with concurrent lockout attempts before release
